title: Seeing a Doctor at a Clinic
context: Maya 因为从周二开始喉咙痛，走进诊所看医生；她向 Owen 医生说明症状、有没有发烧或咳嗽、药物过敏，并询问用药方法和是否需要复诊。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi. I'd like to see a doctor about a sore throat. It started on Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想看医生，因为喉咙痛。从周二就开始了。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Sure. Besides the sore throat, have you noticed any other symptoms?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。除了喉咙痛，你还注意到其他症状吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes, I also have a headache, and it's a little hard to swallow.
dialogue.zh: 有的，我还有点头疼，而且吞咽有点困难。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: I see. Have you had a fever or a cough?
dialogue.zh: 明白了。你有发烧或咳嗽吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I felt a bit warm last night, but I don't have a cough.
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我觉得有点发热，但没有咳嗽。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Okay. Are you allergic to any medicine?
dialogue.zh: 好的。你对什么药物过敏吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Not that I know of. I haven't had any problems before.
dialogue.zh: 据我所知没有。以前也没出过什么问题。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Good. I'll prescribe some lozenges and a short course of medicine.
dialogue.zh: 很好。我会给你开一些含片和一个短期疗程的药。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Thank you. How often should I take the medicine?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。这个药应该多久吃一次？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Take it twice a day after meals for five days.
dialogue.zh: 每天两次，饭后服用，连吃五天。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Got it. Should I come back if it doesn't get better?
dialogue.zh: 明白了。如果没有好转，我需要再来复诊吗？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Yes. If it lasts more than a week, come in again.
dialogue.zh: 需要。如果持续一周以上，请再来一趟。

expressions.zh: 因某症状去看医生。说明看病原因时常用。
expressions.example: I'd like to see a doctor about a sore throat.

expressions.zh: 注意到其他症状。医生询问病情时常用。
expressions.example: Besides the sore throat, have you noticed any other symptoms?

expressions.zh: 对药物过敏。开药前医生常会确认。
expressions.example: Are you allergic to any medicine?

expressions.en: Prescribe a short course of medicine
expressions.zh: 开一个短期疗程的药。医生说明用药安排时常用。
expressions.example: I'll prescribe some lozenges and a short course of medicine.

expressions.en: Come back if it doesn't get better
expressions.zh: 如果没有好转就再来复诊。询问或建议复诊时常用。
expressions.example: Should I come back if it doesn't get better?

pronunciation: 练习 sore throat 的节奏：SORE THROAT。注意 swallow 的重音在前：SWALlow，allergic 重音在第二音节：a-LLER-gic，以及 prescribe 的重音在后：pre-SCRIBE。

practice.title: Part 1 · Health and seeing a doctor
practice.prompt: Do you usually see a doctor when you feel unwell, or do you wait and rest at home?
practice.answer: I usually rest at home if I just have a mild cold. But if I have a sore throat or a fever for several days, I see a doctor at a clinic.

practice.title: Part 2 · A time you visited a clinic
practice.prompt: Describe a time you went to see a doctor. Say why you went, what the doctor asked you, and what happened afterwards.
practice.answer: Last winter I went to a clinic because of a sore throat. The doctor asked about my symptoms and medicine allergies, then prescribed lozenges and a short course of medicine. I felt better after a few days. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Health care in daily life
practice.prompt: Why do some people delay seeing a doctor even when they feel unwell?
practice.answer: Some people think the illness will go away by itself, or they are too busy to visit a clinic. Others may worry about the cost or about taking medicine. However, seeing a doctor early can prevent a small problem from becoming worse.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读。最后练习说明自己的症状、有没有药物过敏，以及如何按时吃药和是否需要复诊。
practice.answer: 用 3–4 句说明你会怎么在诊所看病：症状、药物过敏、用药方法和是否需要复诊。
